scope: Targeted offline inference and real official emitter serialization in temporary files; no transport/group/platform/fault/model/PID or resource setting operations
causal_rule: After a real task failure, only target heartbeat/access timestamp >= task.observed_at proves subsequent liveness; pre-failure access remains reported but cannot refute a later channel loss. A pre-failure fresh heartbeat still prevents confirmation until its real TTL expires. Default TTLs remain45/60/60.
limitations: Explicit local AMP files only; no proof of Monitor ingestion
Unreachable verdict does not identify process death or business failure
No real participant termination or F19 integrated experiment in this check
